hooks.text: NASA’s giant purple umbrella protects our most powerful telescope.
Webb stays frozen while its shield is hot enough to boil.
400 pulleys unfurled a massive shield 500,000 miles from Earth.

title: Webb's $10 Billion Purple Umbrella
description: The James Webb Space Telescope uses a five-layer sunshield thinner than a human hair to survive the Sun's heat and see into the deep past.

beats.text: NASA’s giant purple umbrella protects our most powerful telescope.
beats.visual: artist concept of the James Webb Space Telescope fully deployed in space, 2022

beats.text: Most people think the telescope is just its massive mirrors.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of the hexagonal mirrors of the James Webb Space Telescope, 2022

beats.text: But they'd fail without a shield as big as a tennis court.
beats.visual: photograph of the JWST sunshield during full-scale deployment testing at Northrop Grumman, 2021
queries: JWST sunshield deployment test Northrop Grumman
James Webb Space Telescope sunshield size

beats.text: Engineers folded the massive shield 12 times to fit the rocket.
beats.visual: the James Webb Space Telescope stowed inside the Ariane 5 rocket fairing, 2021
queries: James Webb Space Telescope launch configuration

beats.text: 400 pulleys unfurled it 500,000 miles from Earth.
beats.visual: animation of the JWST mid-boom deployment sequence in deep space, 2022
queries: James Webb Space Telescope sunshield unfurling

beats.text: Five layers thinner than a human hair block the heat.
beats.visual: close-up of the Kapton polyimide film layers used in the JWST sunshield, 2021
queries: James Webb Space Telescope sunshield material

beats.text: A silicon coating stops 200,000 watts of solar energy.
beats.visual: diagram showing the heat dissipation and purple silicon coating of the JWST sunshield, 2022
queries: James Webb Space Telescope silicon coating

beats.text: One side stays frozen at minus 388 degrees.
beats.visual: artist concept of the JWST secondary mirror and gold segments on the dark side, 2022
queries: James Webb Space Telescope shadow side

beats.text: The other side reaches roughly 230 degrees Fahrenheit.

queries: James Webb Space Telescope temperature side
